column1: # B1143 item 3 (issue #463): RECORD 325, the three Shadow Knight disciplines --
#   4504 Leechcurse Discipline, 6236 Reaper Strike, 6268 Lich Sting.
# The record id and the names are re-derived from the lane's own spells_us.txt
# (the first leg's README quoted them wrong); the lane_before probe prints the
# owning class from the DB (`SELECT id,name,class FROM spells WHERE id IN
# (4504,6236,6268)`) -- this leg runs it, class 4 (Shadow Knight).
# Activation = the REAL client path, `/disc <name>` (B1134 P4's working form:
# /disc sends OP_CastSpell slot 10 -> OP_Action with NO OP_BeginCast; the
# oracle draws nothing -- the B1144 no-Target-slot gate, which this leg
# re-verifies). #resetdisc_timer all between casts (B1134 P4b: the single
# 10-minute reuse timer rejected casts 2..4 of P4). Then the GM path
# `#castspell <id> 0` (B1134 P5: 0 ms OP_BeginCast -> draws the Source;
# B1130 e13's GM cast of the target spell 618 targeted the stunned NPC the
# same way) for the record-325 Source rows: 4504 on self, 6236/6268 on
# Command forms are the .fix leg's findings applied (refactor/B1143/plans/
